subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear valued customer, We are pleased to inform you that your flight booking for the upcoming trip to Paris has been successfully confirmed. Your itinerary details are as follows: Flight: ABC Airlines, Date: 25th May 2022, Departure Time: 10:00 AM, Seat: 15A. We hope you have a pleasant journey and look forward to serving you onboard. Should you have any queries or require further assistance, feel free to contact us. Thank you for choosing XYZ Travel Agency.
